scripts.lint: pnpm --filter web lint && node scripts/check-lint-wall.mjs && node scripts/check-color-wall.mjs && node scripts/check-case-collisions.mjs && node scripts/check-sleep-wall.mjs && node scripts/check-docstring-wall.mjs && node scripts/check-ki-filenames.mjs && node scripts/check-ki-citations.mjs && node scripts/check-migration-journal.mjs && node scripts/surface-size.mjs --check
scripts.test:int:if-db:
node apps/web/scripts/db-probe.mjs; probe=$?; if [ $probe -eq 0 ]; then pnpm test:int; elif [ $probe -eq 1 ]; then printf '
================================================================
  SKIPPED: integration tests did NOT run.
  No database answered at DATABASE_URL (reason above).
  Start it with `docker compose up -d`.
  CI runs them. A green `pnpm check` here is NOT a green CI.
================================================================

'; else exit $probe; fi
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm test:int:if-db && node scripts/tier3-stamp.mjs record
